name: Sociology (PMn)

rules.name: Requirements Overview
rules.desc:
• A minimum of 30 graduate-level units. All 30 units for the minor must be in courses taught by faculty appointed in the Department of Sociology.

• Students must enroll in the SOC course offerings (not cross-listed sections).

• Workshops and colloquia do not count towards the PhD minor.
Exceptions:

• Five (5) of these units may be taken as an independent study or directed reading with a member of Department of Sociology faculty.

• Another five (5) units may be taken in a statistics or methods course taught in another department.

limits.label: statistics or methods course in another department

gpa: A grade point average (GPA) of 3.0 (B) or better.
grading: All units must be taken for a letter grade.
transferPolicy: Per policy, all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: You take 30 units of graduate Sociology courses (numbered 200 and above) for a letter grade, not counting workshops or the colloquium, with at most 5 units of independent study or directed research (SOC 390, SOC 391) and 5 units of a statistics or methods course from another department, which you move in by hand. Your 3.0 GPA, and that you enrolled under the SOC listing rather than a cross-listing, are checked by hand.
